functions.name: move
functions.description: Queue a move to world coordinates (Y is north). Executes over the next ticks.

functions.name: scan
functions.description: Queue a scan of the surroundings; takes several ticks to complete.

functions.name: scan_result
functions.description: Peek the latest completed scan: {tick, radius, points} or nil.

functions.name: act
functions.description: Terraforming action stub (kind: plant | drain; params table). Arrives in phase 8.

functions.name: print
functions.description: Write a line to the mission console.

functions.name: coroutine.yield
functions.description: Pause the script until the next tick.
